text: How does this knob know the room is warm?
Hot water flows through this valve into the radiator.
Inside the knob is a little capsule of wax.
As the room warms up, the wax expands.
It pushes a pin down, and the pin shuts the valve.
When the room cools, the wax shrinks, and a spring opens the valve again.
Warm wax grows and shuts off the hot water.
